title: Towers of Hanoi
description:
Three pegs, and a tower of discs on the first, largest at the bottom. Move the whole tower to another peg, one disc at a time, never putting a larger disc on a smaller one.

The recursive solution is three lines of thought. To move `n` discs from peg A to peg C using B as a spare:

1. move the top `n - 1` discs from A to B (out of the way),
2. move the biggest disc from A to C,
3. move the `n - 1` discs from B to C.

Write `void hanoi(int discs, char from, char to, char spare, std::vector<std::string>& moves)` that appends each single move to `moves` as text of the form `"A->C"`.
hints: The base case is zero discs: do nothing. The recursive case is the three steps above; notice how the roles of `to` and `spare` swap in the two recursive calls.
